fun_facts: Cooper Kupp grew up in Yakima, Washington. At 13, he went to a Seahawks game at the old Qwest Field—and got to miss school the next day.

As a freshman at Eastern Washington, Cooper Kupp caught a touchdown in each of his first 14 games, an FCS record. He also set national freshman marks with 92 catches, 1,691 yards, and 21 touchdown catches.
Cooper Kupp was a four-time consensus FCS All-American.
At Eastern Washington, Cooper Kupp set FCS career records with 428 receptions and 73 receiving touchdowns.
In 2021, Cooper Kupp won the NFL receiving triple crown with 145 catches, 1,947 yards, and 16 touchdowns. He was also named MVP of Super Bowl LVI.

basis.reasoning: The player profile lists Eastern Washington as Cooper Kupp's college.
